name: Intentional test failures should use pytest.fail with a message
description: Tests sometimes need to fail on purpose: a feature is not ready, a dependency is blocked, or a branch of the test should never succeed. assert False and assert 0 look like accidental logic bugs rather than deliberate aborts. name: Parametrize decorators should not contain duplicate test cases
description: This rule raises an issue when the argvalues collection of a @pytest.mark.parametrize decorator contains duplicate test cases. In Python with pytest, this occurs when @pytest.mark.parametrize is given an argvalues sequence that repeats the same case more than once (for example duplicate literals, names, or calls).

name: Pytest fixture and mark decorators should use consistent parentheses style
description: This rule raises an issue when an argument-free @pytest.fixture or @pytest.mark.* decorator uses parentheses inconsistently with the configured style. By default, empty parentheses are not allowed, matching the official pytest documentation. Analysis may be configured to require empty parentheses instead.

name: pytest should be imported as a module
description: This rule raises an issue when pytest is imported with from pytest import …​ or under an alias such as import pytest as …​ , instead of a plain import pytest . In Python, this refers to imports such as: from pytest import mark, raises (and other from pytest import …​ forms, including subpackages) import pytest as pt (and other aliases that rename pytest )
